content:
Grateful to share that I have completed my Summer Internship Programme 2026 at the BIHAR JUDICIAL ACADEMY, Patna.

​Under the guidance of Shri Nishi Kant Thakur Sir (Additional Director), this experience gave me a much deeper, practical perspective on how judicial administration and trial procedures operate on the ground.

​During the internship, my research and discussions focused on:

• ​Disposal of sessions trials, criminal appeals, and revisions

• ​Core legal principles governing bail petitions

• ​Appreciation of revenue records and title appeal disposal

​A sincere thank you to the mentors and administration at the Academy for their time, direction, and continuous encouragement throughout this program. Looking forward to applying these insights as I move forward in my legal journey.
